headline: Bibi Nukes 🛡️🍊 Trump's 15-Point Gaza Plan 🕊️❌
text: Bibi Netanyahu 🕍👴 straight-up GHOSTED 👻🙅‍♂️ Trump's Board of Peace 🕊️✌️ 15-point Gaza plan, saying NO WAY JOSE 🚫🤷‍♂️ until Hamas is TRULY UNARMED 🔫🚫 like a real-life Fortnite lobby where everyone drops the loot 🏹💀! The Israeli PM told his cabinet 'Israel rejects the whole 15-point document 📜❌' - no pull-out from Gaza until the terror group is actually disarmed, not some 'fictitious disarmament' 🎭🔫! Trump 🍊🧔 announced what he called a 'monumental step toward lasting peace' 🕊️🏆 but Bibi said Hamas gotta disarm FIRST 🥇 before any Israeli troops bounce 🪂💨! The Hamas squad 🤷‍♂️⚔️ says they'll hand over heavy weapons only if Israel stops ALL aggression and pulls out troops 🛑🚶‍♂️, so basically everyone is playing chicken 🐔🚗 with peace deals! Israel's military 💂‍♂️🔥 keeps striking Gaza even after the October ceasefire 🤝📅, with Bibi doubling down that 'Israel will not withdraw until Hamas is genuinely disarmed' 🛡️🚫! Nickolay Mladenov 🕴️📋 tried to save the day saying the plan is 'verifiable, reversible, and the only way forward' 🛤️✅ but Bibi is NOT having it 😤🙅‍♂️! Even Itamar Ben Gvir 🔥👊 called the draft 'not acceptable' and wants a new cabinet vote 🗳️🚫! With elections coming up 🗓️🏛️ and right-wing coalition members pressuring him to stay TOUGH 💪😠, Bibi is stuck between Trump and his base like choosing between pineapple pizza 🍕🍍 and regular! The war kicked off after Hamas's October 7 attack 🗓️💥 that killed 1,200 Israelis and took 251 hostages 🕊️🚫, leading to Israel's military campaign where over 73,000 have been killed according to Gaza health ministry 📊💔! About 1.9 million Gazans - 90% of the population - are displaced 🏠🚶‍♂️, and massive funerals keep happening for victims of strikes 🪦😢! Bibi says he's chatting with US officials 💬🇺🇸 about next steps but won't budge on real disarmament first 🔫✅, calling any fake version a no-go 🚫👎! Meanwhile Hamas officials told BBC they're ready to 'engage seriously and responsibly' 📞🤝 but want mediators to ensure everyone follows the plan 📋✅! Trump's Gaza peace roadmap 🗺️🕊️ now looks like it hit a dead end with Bibi saying 'we know how to stand our ground' 🦶💪 on these matters! The whole situation is more complicated than a reality TV reunion show 🎭📺 with everyone pointing fingers 👉😤 and nobody wanting to blink first 👀🚫!
